name: overloads_are_not_generated_as_expected_7e1c2977
subject: fix(53181): Overloads Are Not Generated as Expected When Using JsDocOverload Tag to Declare Overloads of Functions Assigned to a Prototype (#53317)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: JSDoc @overload tags on functions assigned to a prototype were not handled correctly, so overload signatures were not generated as expected. The fix centralizes overload tag collection via getJSDocOverloadTags and collects tags across all JSDoc comments.
